com.sun.jndi.rmi.registry

类 ReferenceWrapper

  • java.lang.Object
    • java.rmi.server.RemoteObject
      • java.rmi.server.RemoteServer
        • java.rmi.server.UnicastRemoteObject
          • com.sun.jndi.rmi.registry.ReferenceWrapper
  • 所有已实现的接口:
    RemoteReference, Serializable, Remote

    public class ReferenceWrapper
extends UnicastRemoteObject
implements RemoteReference
    The ReferenceWrapper class is a Remote wrapper for Reference objects. It wraps around a Reference on the server, and makes the Reference accessible to clients.
    作者:
    Scott Seligman
